divergences.upstreamResult: Radix Slot and asChild accept a React element supplied as children-position JSX.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane Slot and asChild consume an element descriptor supplied at a value or prop position.
divergences.rationale: Children-position JSX compiles to an Octane render function rather than a cloneable element descriptor.
divergences.consumerImpact: asChild consumers must pass a descriptor using prop-position JSX, createElement, or a mapped descriptor.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Move the child element to the component API's descriptor position instead of children-position JSX.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane children-position JSX becomes a cloneable descriptor.

divergences.upstreamResult: React primitive components use forwardRef wrappers.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane primitive components receive ref as an ordinary prop.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not require React forwardRef wrapper semantics.
divergences.consumerImpact: Refs are passed directly through component props.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass ref directly; do not wrap Octane components with React forwardRef.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adopts wrapper-based ref forwarding.
